lens: Geometry and proportion first, then materials and colour, then artefacts. Fabrics judged as photo-vs-render crops at a matched physical scale (17 in = 0.43 m seat back width as the ruler; q15 near backs ~215 px vs y_47300 ~135 px, so render crops were downsampled x0.63; e4 vs y_47306 x0.78). Candidate c4 (uncommitted working tree: photo-cut Y tiles, headrest +2.5 cm, fabric over the shell cap, slate cover, fuller pillow, bullnose pan, J arm beam). Measurements: /tmp/claude-0/rater15B/m.py and ms.py (box mean, B/R, L p10/p50 and p90/p50, hf = std of L minus 5 px box blur, bright = fraction of L > 1.5 x median). Crops: /tmp/claude-0/rater15B/tops.png (q15 near-row tops vs y_47300), sheet.png (e2-e8). Lighting and QA camera placement are noted but not scored.

issues.title: Fleck tile too bright and too coarse: snow blobs on pads and backs (regressed)
issues.evidence: e4 mid pad bright fraction 0.27 vs y_47306 mid pad 0.11; p90/p50 2.20 vs 1.65. q16 near seat blobs ~1.2-1.5 cm vs ~0.6 cm in y_47301 (matched by back width). In q15 (tops.png) the render pad flecks are ~2x the photo's in size.
issues.fix: tex_y_fleck: check the physical repeat in tex/sizes.json against the photo crop scale (the blob size says the tile is mapped ~2x too large; halve the repeat size). In make_swatches.py compress the highlights so p90/p50 is ~1.7 and the bright fraction ~0.12 (e.g. gamma 1.3 on L above the median), and tint the flecks to ~#9fb3e6 rather than white.

issues.title: White hood side bands still show head-on (top rim now fixed)
issues.evidence: q15 near row: white band L 178-210 ~15-18 px between adjacent seats (~3-3.5 cm), y_47300 2-4 px (~1 cm). q16 near hood side ~25 px vs ~10 px in y_47301.
issues.fix: 09a_econ.js hood / RS: narrow the hood side wrap by ~2 cm per side, or roll the fabric back's side edge ~2 cm further outboard over the shell, so ~1 cm of white remains head-on.

issues.title: Tick and mosaic tiles flatter than the photos (contrast lost in the flattening)
issues.evidence: Tick: e4 p90/p50 1.81 vs y_47306 2.27, hf 30 vs 48, B/R 1.88 vs 2.08; q15 row-distance p10/p50 0.67 vs 0.45. Mosaic: e4 R p90/p50 1.59 vs 2.14, hf 24 vs 40.
issues.fix: make_swatches.py: after flattening, rescale tick and mosaic L about the mean by ~1.35 (target p90/p50 ~2.1, p10/p50 ~0.47 at close range) and raise tick B/R ~+0.15. Or lower PHOTO_GAIN damping for those two layers in 03_tex.js (shared file, one line each).

issues.title: Diamond ground dark and greyish; stars read large and pale at mid range
issues.evidence: e1 s1 #39436c B/R 1.88 vs y_47306 L #5269ab B/R 2.09. q16 left pads p90/p50 2.01; at that range the photo's diamond seats read as a soft texture.
issues.fix: Lift the diamond ground ~15 % toward #3550a0 (B/R ~2.05) and cut star contrast ~20 % (p90/p50 ~1.6).

issues.title: Head-on cover tall and hangs below the pad; s3/s4 covers bright
issues.evidence: q15 cover height 0.56 back widths, bottom ~40 px (1.5x crop) below the pad bottom; y_47300 0.37 with the bottom at the pad bottom (y_47306 shows the longer hang, see question). Cover/back s3/s4 0.84/1.08 vs 0.54/0.74.
issues.fix: Wait for the user's answer. If y_47300 is the default, shorten the flap ~25 % and drop yCover L ~10 %.

issues.title: Pillow face flat at row distance
issues.fix: Give yPillow a fine low-contrast weave layer and a slightly darker piped rim (~5 mm).

issues.title: Armrest reads as a frame with a strut, not a J sweep
issues.evidence: e7 / e1 vs y_47303: the top bar, post and diagonal read as three members; the photo shows one continuous J curve from pad to post.
issues.fix: Loft the pad and post as one swept tube with a ~6 cm bend radius at the front, and hide or slim the diagonal.

issues.title: Screen proud with a heavy bezel; no recessed bay (carried)
issues.fix: Shrink screen + bezel ~8 % in width, set it back 4 mm, add a 6-8 mm sloped light-grey frame ring.

issues.title: Side-panel fabric smears (triplanar blend) on the diamond seat sides
issues.evidence: e3 side: the diamond stars smear into streaks on the curved side panel.
issues.fix: Integration: bias the triplanar blend sharper (power ~8) on seat fabric, or use the loft UVs on seat sides.

issues.title: Seat shells read grey and neutral (not scored)
issues.evidence: q18 shell #aaadb4 L50 175 B/R 1.06 vs y_47305 #b8bfcd L50 192 B/R 1.11; q17 aisle-facing shell #71737b vs y_47303 #9fafcb.
issues.fix: Lighting: a little more cool fill on aft-facing seat surfaces, or a lower AO weight on vertical seat faces.

issues.title: Camera mismatches (not scored)
issues.evidence: The q15 eye is lower and closer than y_47300's (the near backs are 215 px vs 135 px wide, and the pillows fill the frame bottom). q16 looks at the row ahead; y_47301 looks along the aisle. q17 differs from y_47303.
issues.fix: Match the q15 / q16 / q17 cameras to the photos.

questionsForUser: Headrest cover length: in y_47300 (head-on) the flap ends at the pad bottom; in y_47306 it hangs well below it. Which one is the default position? The render follows y_47306.
Are the y_47300 headrests raised? There the pads sit flush with the back tops; in y_47306 the back rises ~8 cm above the pad. The render follows y_47306.
